defects.title: Two-letter element symbols beginning with C are counted as carbon
defects.trigger: a metabolite whose formula contains Ca, Cl, Co, Cu, Cr, Cd, Ce or Cs; e.g. mets {'cl[c]';'ca2[c]';'caox[c]'}, metFormulas {'Cl';'Ca';'CaC2O4'}, S = sparse([-1;-1;1]), rxns {'R1'}; [hi, zero, nC] = findCarbonRxns(model, 1)
defects.observed: R2025a 2026-11-17: nCarbon = [1 1 1], hiCarbonRxns = {'R1'}, zeroCarbonRxns empty (regexp C(\d*) at line 42 matches the C of the element symbol, only the first match is used at line 47, an empty digit group counts 1 at line 50)
defects.expected: nCarbon = [0 0 2] (header: 'The number of carbons in each metabolite' from the 'metabolite elemental formulas'); a reaction of chloride or calcium alone in zeroCarbonRxns

notes: independent review T027/T028: reviewer finding confirmed and regraded from limitation to wrong-result (documented formula input, documented nCarbon output wrong); test converted to the quarantine layout. Reproduction: m.mets={'cl[c]';'ca2[c]';'caox[c]'}; m.metFormulas={'Cl';'Ca';'CaC2O4'}; m.S=sparse([-1;-1;1]); m.rxns={'R1'}; [hi,zc,nC]=findCarbonRxns(m,1) -> nC=[1;1;1], hi={'R1'}, zc empty. Reach: the defect depends on the formulas in the model, not on a call form recognisable in calling code, so every call reaches it. src callers: src/design/multiProductionEnvelope.m line 69 CRxns = findCarbonRxns(model,1) (threshold 1 is exactly where chloride/calcium reactions are wrongly selected).
confirmed_by: lead (review T027/T028; header promises carbon counts; formulas Cl, Ca, CaC2O4 give [1 1 1] instead of [0 0 2] (l.42, 47-50); writer's MATLAB reproduction)

defects.title: Continuation lines of long names are printed as the literal text %30s in the host layout
defects.trigger: printUptakeBoundCom(model, true, true) on a model with a host whose community metabolite name has more than 30 characters
defects.observed: R2025a: each continuation line reads '%30s' (format of line 121 starts with '%%')
defects.expected: the remaining characters of the name, 30 per line

defects.title: A model without indCom cannot be printed
defects.trigger: printUptakeBoundCom(model) for a model with infoCom but without indCom
defects.observed: R2025a 2026-11-17: "Undefined function 'infoCom2indCom' for input arguments of type 'struct'." at line 37 (local function of SteadyComSubroutines.m, not on the path)
defects.expected: indCom derived from infoCom, as the branch intends; the input is not documented (header lists both .infoCom and .indCom as fields of the model)

defects.title: A model without infoCom fails after the default abbreviations are built
defects.trigger: printUptakeBoundCom(model) for a model with indCom but without infoCom
defects.observed: R2025a 2026-11-17: 'Unrecognized field name "infoCom".' at line 62 although line 46 builds default abbreviations
defects.expected: bounds printed with default abbreviations from indCom alone; the input is not documented (header lists both fields)

notes: independent review T027/T028: both reviewer reproductions confirmed (infoCom only: error at line 37; indCom only: error at line 62). Kept as limitation under the lead's rule: the header's INPUT block reads 'model: the community COBRA model, with fields: * .infoCom - struct of community exchange reaction/metabolite names, obtained from getMultiSpeciesModelId * .indCom - struct of the corresponding community exchange indices * .mets ... * .metNames ... * .lb ... * .ub', i.e. both fields are listed as fields of the model with nothing marking either as optional (getMultiSpeciesModelId returns both); only the code (lines 33-37, message of line 35) accepts either alone, so a model with one of them is an undocumented input. Header entries now quote the header and carry the date; no assertion changed. No src callers.

independent review T027/T028: WEAK finding fixed: added a section whose labels differ between <= and < at a distance exactly equal to epsilon: computeEcosystemDBSCAN([0 1; 1 0], 1, 2) = [0; 0] and, on the test's line positions, computeEcosystemDBSCAN(D, 0.1, 3) = [0;0;0;-1;-1;-1] (D(1,2) and D(2,3) are exactly 0.1, asserted; with < every point would be noise). The 'point reached twice' section is renamed to say only what it shows. No defect.

independent review T027/T028: WEAK finding fixed: the stored files now also hold rxnNames and metNames (fields FBA does not need); the minimal load asserts they are absent (only the 14 requested fields return), the nested-file and missing-C full loads assert they are present. A load(modPath) implementation now fails the first section. No defect.

independent review T027/T028: robustness note fixed: right after saving originalPath the test creates restorePath = onCleanup(@() setenv('PATH', originalPath)), so a failing assertion cannot leave MATLAB's PATH pointing at the stub folder; the clean-up section clears restorePath and asserts PATH equals originalPath. Coverage and assertions otherwise unchanged; exemptions unchanged (macOS, Windows, unreachable, dead code).

defects.title: The documented default figure width does not match the code
defects.trigger: plotQuantitativeFluxCoupling(qfca) with fewer panels than colWrap (three points, default colWrap 4)
defects.observed: R2025a 2026-11-17: figure Position [100 100 900 260]; line 52 uses 300 * nCols with nCols = min(colWrap, nPanels) (line 49); the call succeeds
defects.expected: header line 19 documents [300 * colWrap, 260 * nRows], width 1200 here (the code's width is the sensible one: the header misdescribes it)

notes: independent review T027/T028: unrecorded cosmetic confirmed (R2025a: default Position [100 100 900 260] for 3 panels, header says 300 * colWrap = 1200) and added to the header. To avoid asserting behaviour that contradicts the header, the default-options section now asserts Position([1 2 4]) = [100 100 260] only; the width rule is still asserted in the colWrap = 2 section (600 x 520), where header and code agree. Coverage unchanged (all lines).

defects.title: An empty cond1_upt_higher list stops with an error
defects.trigger: setSemiQuantConstraints(m, m, cell(0,2), {'EX_a',0.5}, {'EX_b',10}, {'EX_b',10}) with m = createModel({'EX_a','EX_b'},{'EX_a','EX_b'},{'a <=> ','b <=> '}); any call with an empty cond1_upt_higher and a non-empty secretion list
defects.observed: R2025a 2026-11-17: "Unrecognized function or variable 'c'." at line 76 (c is first set inside the cond1_upt_higher loop, line 62); with both secretion lists also empty the call succeeds
defects.expected: no bound changed for the empty list, the other lists applied (header line 23: the exchanges with higher uptake in condition 1, a set that can be empty; cond2_upt_higher works when empty)

notes: independent review T027/T028: reviewer finding confirmed and regraded from limitation to error: an empty list is a valid value of the documented argument (the wave test itself passed cell(0,2) for the sibling cond2_upt_higher and asserted the result); that calculateQuantitativeDiffs never returns an empty list is an upstream matter and does not make the input undocumented. Test converted to the quarantine layout. Reproduction: m = createModel({'EX_a','EX_b'},{'EX_a','EX_b'},{'a <=> ','b <=> '}); setSemiQuantConstraints(m, m, cell(0,2), {'EX_a',0.5}, {'EX_b',10}, {'EX_b',10}) -> error at line 76; setSemiQuantConstraints(m, m, cell(0,2), {'EX_a',0.5}, cell(0,2), cell(0,2)) succeeds. Reach: the form is 'cond1_upt_higher empty while cond2_secr_higher or cond1_secr_higher is non-empty', a data value not recognisable in calling code. src callers: none (grep -w over src finds no call), so the quarantine blocks no caller.
confirmed_by: lead (review T027/T028; c is first set inside the cond1 loop (l.62) and read at l.76, so an empty cond1_upt_higher list, which the test itself passes as valid elsewhere, errors; writer's MATLAB reproduction)

defects.title: The help text names the wrong solver and the wrong LP
defects.observed: 2026-11-17, by reading: line 2 reads 'CPLEX implementation of LP-9 for input sets K, P (see FASTCORE paper)', but the code (lines 36-54) is CVX and the problem is LP-10; no call is affected
defects.expected: 'CVX implementation of LP-10 for input sets K, P (see FASTCORE paper)'

notes: independent review T027/T028: WEAK finding addressed: added a section gated on exist('cvx_begin','file') == 2 that solves the 3x4 chain with K = 1, P = [3;4], epsilon = 1e-4 and asserts the hand-derived unique optimum (V = 0.1*ones(4,1), objective |v3|+|v4| = 0.2 = 2e3*epsilon, S*V = 0, scaled bounds, tolerance 1e-6 for CVX's default precision), with cvx_quiet saved and restored; without CVX it prints a skip message. CVX is not installed here (exist = 0), so the section did not run and was not executed on this machine; the CVX-language lines stay exempt. Header's CPLEX/LP-9 wording recorded as cosmetic.

defects.title: The share of metabolites with a compartment ('Total' row) is inverted
defects.trigger: a plain model with metabolite ids lacking a '[x]' suffix, e.g. TmodelStats(struct('rxns',{{'R1'}}, 'mets',{{'a[c]';'b[c]';'glc'}}, 'S',sparse([1;-1;0])))
defects.observed: R2025a 2026-11-17: Stats.metsByComp{end,2} = [2 1.5] (line 123: count \ nMets = nMets/count); ids {'a_c';'b_c'} give [0 Inf]; with every id suffixed both give 1
defects.expected: [2 0.6667] and [0 0] (line 112 'Total metabolite with compartment (should be 100%)', line 120 share = nMetsInComp / nMets; header line 2 'Can also be used on a normal model')

notes: independent review T027/T028: reviewer finding confirmed in MATLAB (Total = [2 1.5] for the reviewer's model, [0 Inf] for ids 'a_c','b_c'); wrong-result by the code's evident intent on the documented 'normal model' input. Test converted to the quarantine layout. Reproduction: st = TmodelStats(struct('rxns',{{'R1'}}, 'mets',{{'a[c]';'b[c]';'glc'}}, 'S',sparse([1;-1;0]))); st.metsByComp{end,2} -> [2 1.5]. Reach: the form is 'a model with at least one metabolite id without a [x] suffix' (a data property, not a call form). src callers: src/reconstruction/comparison/modelBorgifier/mergeModelsBorg.m line 223 Stats = TmodelStats(TmodelC, Stats), where TmodelC is built from models that verifyModelBorg.m (lines 220-252) forces to a '[x]' suffix on every metabolite, so this caller does not reach the defect (moderate confidence: a hand-made Tmodel passed to mergeModelsBorg without verifyModelBorg would); TmodelFields.m only names it in a comment.
confirmed_by: lead (review T027/T028; l.123 computes total\nMets, the inverse of the share the comment at l.112 and the pattern at l.120 compute; writer's MATLAB reproduction)

defects.title: The documented default of inputDataFolder is not implemented
defects.trigger: writeReactionsFromPubSeedSpreadsheets(infoFilePath, [], spreadsheetFolder) (or '') from a folder with the info file, InReactions.txt and the VMH database
defects.observed: R2025a 2026-11-17 Linux: "Unable to open file '/genomeAnnotation.txt' for writing" at line 129 ([[] filesep 'genomeAnnotation'] is in the file-system root); ./InputData not written
defects.expected: genomeAnnotation.txt written to ./InputData (header lines 11-12: default folder in current path called "InputData")

notes: independent review T027/T028: reviewer finding confirmed (error at line 129 writing to the root; nothing in ./InputData); classified unusable-option under the rule (documented default not implemented, the documented omission fails; same as classifyRxns and getSubsystemPresence). Test converted to the quarantine layout. Reproduction: the wave test's sandbox (git history), then writeReactionsFromPubSeedSpreadsheets(fullfile(sandboxDir,'infoNumeric.txt'), [], emptySpreadsheetDir) from sandboxDir -> "Unable to open file '/genomeAnnotation.txt' for writing". Reach: the form is an empty inputDataFolder ([] or ''). src callers: src/reconstruction/demeter/src/integration/prepareInputData.m line 211 passes inputDataFolder, which is the parser value with default [pwd filesep 'InputData'] (line 34) and was already used by mkdir (line 44) and writetable (line 119) before; it never passes an empty folder. gapfillRefinedGenomeReactions.m only names it in a comment. No caller omits the argument: seed NONE.
confirmed_by: lead (review T027/T028; documented default inputDataFolder is not implemented, an empty value writes to /genomeAnnotation.txt (l.129); unusable-option as for classifyRxns; writer's MATLAB reproduction)
